notes: The 4-page PDF also contains pages or columns of two unrelated Science articles (a BSCCO STM paper and an NMDA receptor paper); these were ignored. Uptake is measured by TGA weight gain in flowing H2 at ambient pressure (gravimetric/flow). The authors interpret it as dissociative hydrogenation (LiH and C-H formation, p. 92), but a weight uptake in wt% is measured, so I1 is met. Sorbents are Li- and K-doped multiwalled CNT and graphite, with Li/C and K/C about 1/15 (carbon is the majority by mass). I4: the only surface areas (130 m2/g CNT, 8.6 m2/g graphite) are for the undoped parent materials, method not stated; none is given for the doped samples. Undoped CNT is a sample the paper reports measurements on (Fig. 2a FTIR; Table 1 row CNT, 0.4 wt%, attributed to ref. 9). The area_same_sample question (parent_material) is for extraction, not eligibility. record.json is_retracted is false and the text has no retraction statement. The paper does not state that all its uptake values were published before (only the undoped 0.4 wt% is cited to ref. 9), so duplicate_data does not apply.
